prompt:
Task: Create and edit a Google Doc titled "Feature Test Document"
Create a new Google Doc named "Feature Test Document".
Set the page to Letter size, 1-inch margins, portrait.
Add a title at the top using the Title style, and a Subtitle line with today's date.
Set the title font to Playfair Display, enlarged.
Write a 2–3 sentence intro paragraph (any topic) in Roboto, size 11.
Have one sentence in the intro in a different font (e.g. Merriweather).
In the intro: one word bold, one italic, one underlined, one word with blue text color, one word with yellow highlight.
One phrase in the doc in a monospace font (e.g. Roboto Mono).
Three section headers using Heading 1: "Section One", "Section Two", "Section Three".
Under Section One: a numbered list of 3 items, a bulleted list of 3 items, and a checklist with 2 items (one checked off).
Section One starts on page 2 (page break after the intro).
Under Section Two: a filled 3×4 table with a header row (Name / Value / Notes).
The table's header row is bold with a background color.
Two cells merged in the table's last row.
